# infrawrench_seat_settings (Resource)

Organization-wide setting for the Seats findings: paid SaaS seats (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, GitLab, Okta, Claude Enterprise, Docker Hub, Tailscale) that nobody has used for a while, that duplicate another tool the same person pays for, or that sit on a dearer tier than their usage needs.

An organization **singleton**: the row always exists, so `terraform destroy` restores the shipped default rather than deleting anything. Reading needs the `costs:read` permission and writing needs `costs:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Flag paid SaaS seats (Copilot, Cursor, GitLab, Okta...) nobody has used for
# 45 days, rather than the shipped 30.
resource "infrawrench_seat_settings" "this" {
  inactive_days = 45
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `inactive_days` (Number) How many days a paid seat may go unused before it is flagged as inactive, 7–365. Ships as 30. A seat assigned more recently than this is never flagged, and a provider that reports no activity for a seat never has it flagged, whatever the value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id. Seat settings is an organization singleton, so this is the only value it ever takes and it is what `terraform import` addresses.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization singleton: there is only ever one, and it has no id of its
# own, so it imports under the organization id.
terraform import infrawrench_seat_settings.this org_01HXYZABCDEF
```
